bead.title: Docs cleanup and TOCTOU prerequisite
bead.description:
PROBLEM
The relational module docs still describe the projection family as DB-authoritative, and the ADR migration still needs to keep the `pqueue-b59f4897` multi-node TOCTOU prerequisite explicit instead of burying it.
ROOT CAUSE
`crates/pqueue-postgres/src/relational.rs:3-9, 2772-2779` and `crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational.rs:3-9, 4039-4040, 8425-8428` still use authoritative wording, while `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-013-log-single-source-of-truth.md:126-135` names `pqueue-b59f4897` as a hard prerequisite.
PROPOSED FIX
Remove "authoritative" wording from the relational module docs, replace it with rebuildable-cache language consistent with ADR-013/TD-001, and keep the `pqueue-b59f4897` prerequisite explicit in the migration notes and test references.
NON-SCOPE
runtime behavior changes, replay plumbing, and conformance coverage beyond the prerequisite reference.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestRelationalDocsDropDBAuthoritativeLanguage` removes the DB-authoritative/authoritative wording from the postgres and sqlite relational module docs.
2. `TestRelationalPrereqReferencesTOCTOUBead` keeps `pqueue-b59f4897` explicitly referenced in the migration notes and test comments.
3. `cargo test -p pqueue-postgres --test relational_conformance -- --list` and `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite --test relational_conformance -- --list` still pass after the doc cleanup.
4. `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
